title: Record public maximal-order corpus sweep
objective: Retain the complete bounded 443-case public maximal-order sweep and corrected proof-case reruns as checked machine-readable and concise human artifacts

oracles: independent exact lattice verifier against the certified 494-case corpus

handoff.summary: Recorded all 443 raw bounded public Sage.js results at b60ed9aa, independently verified 409 exact lattices, retained 34 timeouts, and separately verified the five corrected proof-completeness cases in fresh workers with a generous bound. The concise Markdown report records commit, host, CPU, Node, native hash, policy, exact timeout IDs, stage totals, and interpretation.
risks: This is a Linux-x64, zero-warmup, single-sample correctness/resource sweep and is explicitly not a stable cross-platform performance benchmark.
The uniform five-second policy intentionally classifies 34 cases as timeouts; five of those are separately proved correct by generous fresh-worker reruns.
next_steps: Use the retained timeout IDs and raw stage records to prioritize certification, discriminant decomposition, and high-degree local-order performance work.
Repeat the same checked policy on Linux arm64 and macOS arm64 when comparable native artifacts are available.
